asks: Grande Prairie's mayor asks the commission to keep all seven northern ridings, not fold Lesser Slave Lake into Mackenzie or delete Peace River, using section 15 variances.

quote: The proposal to consolidate northern ridings, particularly by folding Lesser Slave Lake into a new, expansive “Mackenzie” division and effectively deleting the long-standing Peace River riding, runs counter to the Commission’s mandate
note: City of Grande Prairie. Asks to 'preserve existing northern constituencies' and retain all seven ridings (p. 60); Lesser Slave Lake is one of them.

asks: Retain the seven northern districts, drop the name changes, limit hybrid ridings and stop merging rural districts (including Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre) to add urban seats.

quote: At a minimum retain the existing seven northern districts to preserve accessibility for MLAs and constituents in remote areas.
note: Names Lesser Slave Lake on p. 62 as one of the districts being merged ('the merging of areas like Central Peace-Notley and Lesser Slave Lake into expanded districts'); the want is for all seven northern districts, not Lesser Slave Lake alone.

quote: the reduction of rural central-west districts from six to five, including the elimination of Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre to accommodate growth in the Airdrie-Cochrane area, shifts power toward urban and suburban regions
note: Mackenzie County resident. Objects to the riding's elimination as part of a general case against cutting rural seats; asks to 'avoid merging rural districts'. No particulars about Clearwater County or Sundre.
'the Airdrie-Cochrane area' named only as where growth is being accommodated.
'the Airdrie-Cochrane area' named only as where growth is being accommodated.

asks: Allow larger population variances for far northern rural ridings and make city ridings denser.
Mackenzie County asks the commission to remove the proposed rural population reallocations, keep rural communities with their service hubs and keep historic division names.
The MD of Smoky River asks the commission to preserve current rural and northern boundaries and not eliminate the Lesser Slave Lake riding.

quote: particularly the reduction of northern Alberta constituencies from seven to six and the elimination of the Lesser Slave Lake riding
note: MD of Smoky River. Also asks to 'Preserve the current boundaries for rural and northern constituencies' (p. 72).

asks: A High Prairie resident of Lesser Slave Lake disagrees with moving the boundaries.

quote: Absolutely disagree with moving the boundaries
note: Whole message is these six words. Place comes from the form header: High Prairie, current division '70 - Lesser Slave Lake', submission about '76 - Peace River-Notley'. Read as wanting the current division kept.

asks: Do not eliminate the Lesser Slave Lake division or add Slave Lake to another one.

quote: its unfair for Lesser Slave Lake to lose its own division. I strongly oppose the reports recommendation to eliminate our division and add our community to another one.
note: Slave Lake resident.

asks: Do not take representatives away from the north (writer lives in Lesser Slave Lake).

quote: You will be taking away from the north the representation that it requires. With taking away 2 representatives our voices will not be heard.
note: Lesser Slave Lake is named only in the form header (Canyon Creek; current '70 - Lesser Slave Lake'; about '80 - Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca'). The message objects to the north losing representatives and praises the current MLA; it does not name the riding. A second reader could fairly code no want.

asks: Thanks the commission for keeping Edmonton ridings inside the city and asks for more Edmonton MLAs, especially on the south side.
Keep Edmonton's ridings inside the city and give Edmonton more seats.
Do not split or greatly reshape Calgary-Elbow, and give Calgary one more seat.
Keep Sundre and Rocky Mountain House connected in a western riding rather than placing Sundre in Mountain View-Kneehill.

quote: We respectfully urge you to reconsider the boundary plan and to keep Sundre and Rocky Mountain House connected, ensuring representation that reflects shared western interests.
note: Clearwater County resident; header current '80 - Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre', about '75 - Mountain View-Kneehill'. Near-copy of EBC-2025-2-0137 (same points, reworded).

quote: Sundre maintains a stronger social, economic, and cultural connection with Rocky Mountain House to the north and with the MD of Bighorn and Banff to the west.
note: Offered as a community-of-interest argument for a western grouping, not as a request to put Bighorn or the park in the riding. 'Banff' is not specified as park or townsite. A second reader could fairly code no want.

quote: Moreover, linking Sundre with communities east of Highway 22 dilutes the collective voice of west-central Albertans, as those areas have different industries, priorities, and needs.
note: Partial request: Sundre out of Mountain View-Kneehill and with Rocky Mountain House. Nothing about Crossfield, Irricana or Beiseker.

asks: Align Sundre with Rocky Mountain House and other western communities rather than placing it in Mountain View-Kneehill.

quote: We respectfully request that you reconsider these boundary changes and align western communities—such as Sundre and Rocky Mountain House—to ensure effective representation for residents with shared western interests.
note: Clearwater County resident; header current '80 - Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre', about '75 - Mountain View-Kneehill'. campaign: near-copy of EBC-2025-2-0136 (same points, reworded).

quote: Sundre shares deeper socio-economic and cultural ties with Rocky Mountain House to the north and with the MD of Bighorn and Banff to the west.
note: Offered as a community-of-interest argument for a western grouping, not as a request to put Bighorn or the park in the riding. 'Banff' is not specified as park or townsite. A second reader could fairly code no want. campaign: EBC-2025-2-0136.

quote: The proposed boundaries risk diminishing the voice of west-central Albertans by pairing us with communities east of Highway 22 that have different industries, priorities, and challenges.
note: Partial request: Sundre out of Mountain View-Kneehill and with Rocky Mountain House. campaign: EBC-2025-2-0136.

asks: Keep all of Chappelle in Edmonton-South and use Anthony Henday Drive as its northern boundary.
No request; says the redistribution criteria keep costing the north and west representation and the review is a waste.
The Town of Whitecourt asks the commission not to eliminate a northern Alberta seat.
Rocky Gas Co-op's board asks that all of Clearwater County and Rocky Mountain House be kept in one constituency.

quote: ensure that the final electoral boundaries have all of Clearwater County and Rocky Mountain House included in the same constituency
note: Rocky Gas Co-op board. Objects to 'the Boundary Commission’s proposal to eliminate the Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre constituency and divide Clearwater County between three different ridings'; the request itself is only that the county stay whole, with nothing said about Sundre or Lacombe. Banff-Jasper is named only as one of the three ridings the county would be divided among.

asks: Redraw the Olds-area riding between Highway 22 and the Red Deer River, including Irricana and Beiseker, and do not remove a central Alberta seat.

quote: I respectfully recommend the following boundaries, which better reflect existing partnerships: • West Boundary: Highway 22 • East Boundary: Red Deer River
note: Olds-Didsbury-Three Hills resident and constituency association member. Also 'South Boundary: Include the communities of Irricana and Beiseker', and disagrees with 'the creation and naming of the Mountain View–Kneehill constituency' (p. 98). Crossfield is not named.

quote: extends the western boundary far past Rocky Mountain House. The communities west of Highway 22 have very different geographic and economic characteristics than those of Mountain View County and Kneehill County.
note: Says the area west of Highway 22 does not belong in the prairie riding; makes no request about where Rocky Mountain House or Clearwater County should go.

asks: Give Medicine Hat one fully urban division instead of two hybrid divisions.

note: Lethbridge named as a comparable city that is not hybrid, to argue for a fully urban Medicine Hat division; no request about Lethbridge.
Red Deer named as a comparable city that is not hybrid, to argue for a fully urban Medicine Hat division; no request about Red Deer.

asks: Give Medicine Hat one fully urban division instead of two hybrid divisions.

note: campaign: EBC-2025-2-0143. Lethbridge named as a comparable city that is not hybrid, to argue for a fully urban Medicine Hat division; no request about Lethbridge.
campaign: EBC-2025-2-0143. Red Deer named as a comparable city that is not hybrid, to argue for a fully urban Medicine Hat division; no request about Red Deer.

asks: Woodlands County Council asks the commission not to consolidate the county into a West Yellowhead division reaching Grande Cache and to keep its second MLA.
No request; thanks the commission for keeping Edmonton ridings inside the city and adding a south Edmonton seat.
Give Edmonton at least one more seat; thanks the commission for not joining Ellerslie to Leduc or Sherwood Park.
A Lesser Slave Lake resident says no to the new, larger divisions in the north.

quote: No to new divisions. Northern Albertan’s concerns will be ignored and pushed aside with a larger division.
note: Riding named only in the form header (Sucker Creek First Nation; current '70 - Lesser Slave Lake'; about the boundaries as a whole). 'I stand with Scott Sinclair', the Lesser Slave Lake MLA.

asks: A Slave Lake resident does not approve of the proposal to break up her community's division.

quote: We contribute alot here in our community and you want to break us up why ?
note: Riding named only in the form header (Slave Lake; current '70 - Lesser Slave Lake'; about '80 - Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca'). 'Why are fixing something that's not broken?'

asks: Do not take a riding away from rural northern Alberta; add urban divisions instead.

quote: Do not take away from the rural, Northern Alberta riding. We are just as important, and we need our voices heard!!
note: Riding named only in the form header (Lesser Slave River MD 124; current '70 - Lesser Slave Lake').

asks: Reverse the proposed changes to Edmonton-South: keep Chappelle in it and use Anthony Henday Drive as the northern boundary.
Keep a Lesser Slave Lake constituency and redraw it to add Northern Sunrise County and the east side of the Town of Peace River.

quote: Re-draw the boundaries of Lesser Slave Lake constituency to include Northern Sunrise County and the east side of the Town of Peace River.
note: Resident of the current riding who feels 'alienated as I watch it carved up'. Wants the riding kept and enlarged westward (Northern Sunrise County, east Peace River); neither final map adds those areas, so direction only.

asks: Reconsider the proposed boundary changes in general; no place is named.
Keep central Alberta's seats and draw the Innisfail-area riding from Blackfalds to Bowden along Highway 2 with Delburne, Elnora and Trochu along Highway 21.

note: Former MP. Red Deer appears as the end of a dealership corridor and in the federal riding name Red Deer-Lacombe. Proposes a rural riding from Blackfalds to Bowden; does not say whether any town should share a district with part of the city.

Asks that Trochu be in the Innisfail-area riding ('include agriculture communities along the Highway 21 corridor including Delburne, Elnora and Trochu'). Trochu lies in the Olds-area riding on the minority map, but the writer never names that riding or says what it should contain, so no want is coded.

asks: Keep Lacombe-Ponoka as it is rather than splitting it into Wetaskiwin-Maskwacis-Ponoka and Lacombe-Rocky Mountain House.

quote: What do Lacombe and Rocky Mountain House have in common beyond being two rural central Alberta communities?
note: Lacombe resident; wants Lacombe-Ponoka kept. Argues against joining Lacombe with Rocky Mountain House at all ('an entirely different region'), which is the eastward join W2 describes; says nothing of Clearwater County being whole or divided, so W3 is not coded and no want is given for the west-central riding.
Says Lacombe, Ponoka and Blackfalds are 'akin to bedroom communities of Red Deer' and tied to 'the Red Deer metro region'; no request about the city's districts.

asks: Do not split Lacombe-Ponoka; if it must grow, extend it east toward Stettler rather than west to Rocky Mountain House.

quote: I suggest that extending it east towards Stettler would make more sense as we share more in common with this area than with Rocky Mountain House
note: Lacombe resident; wants Lacombe-Ponoka kept, or extended east. Argues against joining Lacombe with the Rocky Mountain House area; no want for the west-central riding itself.

asks: Give Medicine Hat one fully urban division instead of two hybrid divisions.

note: campaign: EBC-2025-2-0143. Lethbridge named as a comparable city that is not hybrid, to argue for a fully urban Medicine Hat division; no request about Lethbridge.
campaign: EBC-2025-2-0143. Red Deer named as a comparable city that is not hybrid, to argue for a fully urban Medicine Hat division; no request about Red Deer.

asks: No change requested; supports the proposed Camrose division with Hay Lakes added.
Move the line between the two Lethbridge ridings to 12th Street so the writer stays in Lethbridge-West, and keep Lethbridge as two urban ridings.

quote: it is good that our overall urban community remains as two urban ridings, without being lumped together with smaller nearby communities, or having our community's representation diluted by being chopped up into more ridings
note: Also asks that the line between the two city ridings move to 12th Street (attached map, p. 24), which this element does not cover.

asks: Do not take away Slave Lake's representation by joining it with Westlock and Athabasca.

quote: I feel taking away slave lakes representation will take away what we need most is a voice. Athabasca and westlock are almost 200km away from slave lake and don’t have the same concerns as us
note: Slave Lake resident; header current '70 - Lesser Slave Lake', about '80 - Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca'.

asks: A Beiseker councillor asks that Beiseker be kept in a rural riding (a rural Rocky View riding or Olds-Didsbury-Three Hills) rather than Airdrie-East.

quote: Placing Beiseker in a central-Alberta rural constituency (whether the existing Olds-Didsbury-Three Hills or a modified version) that reflects our established service, economic, and social ties with communities along and east of Highway 2.
note: Beiseker councillor. Offers two options without ranking them; the other is 'Retaining Beiseker within a reconfigured Rocky View constituency'. Opposes 'The proposal to remove Beiseker [...] and incorporate it into a redrawn and expanded Airdrie-East constituency'. Calls the current division 'Rocky View', which is not its name.
Airdrie named as the urban centre that would dominate Airdrie-East; nothing said about how the city itself is divided.
Says Airdrie-East would be anchored by Airdrie 'and the City of Chestermere', which the interim map does not do; no request about Chestermere.

asks: Move polling divisions 43, 44 and 45 from Morinville-St. Albert to St. Albert, keeping the urban-rural riding.

quote: By moving polling divisions 43, 44, and 45 from Morinville-St. Albert to St. Albert, we can better accommodate the rapid growth occurring in North Erin Ridge.
note: Sturgeon resident. Moves three polls out of the hybrid into the city district; also says the 'rurban' riding 'should be preserved' (S0). Which final map matches depends on where polls 43 to 45 lie.

asks: The Town of Canmore asks that the proposed Banff-Jasper division's name begin with Canmore.
Include Huxley and Trochu in the new Innisfail riding.

note: Asks that Huxley and Trochu be in the new Innisfail riding. Trochu lies in the Olds-area riding on the minority map, but the writer never names that riding, so no want is coded.
